description: This file contains unit tests for the Vacancy entity within the Recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It defines a test class 'VacancyTest' that sets up test data, creates Vacancy objects, and makes assertions about their properties.

classes.name: VacancyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the Vacancy entity, extending a base test case. Contains setup and test methods to verify Vacancy entity properties and persistence behavior.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating Vacancy-related tables before each test.

methods.name: testVacancyEntity
methods.description: Creates and initializes a Vacancy object, persists it, retrieves it from the repository, and asserts that its properties are correctly saved and retrieved.
